retirement_sequence: Free-following dogs are centered and withdrawn after0.60mm seating. Remaining sticky pins seat after1.15mm total; head then rises0.55mm to center their dogs before withdrawal. These nominal distances do not replace observed manual fit/support checks.
limits: Exact nominal backlash/slot dimensions and rigid parts. Restoring ground support before final seating is essential. Does not qualify friction, force, print variation, manually observed individual dog retirement or blind automatic overtravel.
